prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: RETURN-1 C2 reusable orbital rocket industrial design reference board.
Primary request: Restyle the existing rocket so it unmistakably belongs to the avokado Motion Tower product family, preserving the existing two-stage reusable rocket architecture.
Input images, in order:
1. EDIT TARGET: RETURN-1 C1 rocket concept board. Keep its three-view idea, basic slender two-stage rocket silhouette, upper-stage windward thermal-protection surface, retained payload door, retractable landing gear and compact control surfaces.
2. STYLE REFERENCE: avokado Motion Tower single product photograph/render. Transfer its cold satin-brushed silver, narrow glossy black vertical rounded-rectangle panel, fine cyan accents, restrained continuous cylindrical proportions and crisp fine horizontal joins.
3. STYLE REFERENCE: four avokado towers and Hub. Transfer its refined dark-studio mood and coherent silver/black/cyan product family, NOT the holograms or physical device count.

Make a clearly revised beautiful C2 design, not just a background swap. Replace every ivory rocket surface and muted broad teal band with fine brushed silver and very thin cyan identification trim. A slender black pill-shaped vertical service-panel motif on the leeward upper stage is the visual signature; three very small cyan dots within it echo the tower's ordered dots as a graphic motif ONLY, not actual three cameras, not crew windows. Echo a much smaller black pill on a lower service region. Add precise shallow silver circumferential joins, no exposed sliding/extendable telescope. Fine cyan rings remain minimal, graphic trim rather than luminous propulsion. Keep the nose a rounded aerodynamic ogive, not a flat tower cap. Keep the dark graphite windward heat-protection surface separate and visible in the secondary view. Do not remove the thermal protection or paint it silver. Silver appearance does not define structural material.

Composition: premium landscape 3:2 product-design board on charcoal/dark-gray studio backdrop with soft vertical light gradient, very subtle floor reflection and enough space around each view. Left ~45%: entire upright assembled rocket in a three-quarter leeward view with black vertical panel and silver silhouette clearly visible. Right top ~55%: same upper-stage module, horizontal three-quarter windward view, charcoal thermal face clearly visible. Right bottom: same upper-stage module from leeward side with its attached payload door open, showing empty bay, black inset motif on the door's outer skin. All three views must be coherent, same stage geometry and finish. Small lower-corner inset of ONE silver avokado Motion Tower reference as a separate scale-free family cue, with text AVOKADO FAMILY only, never physically attached to the rocket. No human, no launchpad, no flames, no space scene, no holograms, no spacecraft powered by beams.

Lighting/materials: broad white studio strip highlights reveal the brushed satin silver, subtle cyan accents, matte graphite TPS, sparse polished edge detail. Functional clean surfaces, precision instruments, minimal industrial design; no excessive sci-fi greebles, spikes, fins, external tanks or decorative giant glass.
Text verbatim: heading "RETURN-1 / C2" and small subtitle "AVOKADO DESIGN LANGUAGE". Small footer "EXTERNAL CONCEPT - NOT FOR FABRICATION". The reference inset label "AVOKADO FAMILY". No other captions, measurements, numbers or dimensional claims.
Constraints: exactly two main stages, not four boosters; spacecraft payload stays distinct from ground avokado. Do not add functional unverified sensors or technical internals. The new design must look meaningfully closer to reference 2 than the ivory original.
